title: _brand.yml: the house style as a file

steps.say: No brand file yet: Quarto's default look. Colours and fonts live in no file at all.
Name the colours once in palette, then give them jobs: primary for links and accents, foreground for text. The report itself does not change.
Fonts come from files kept with the project, not from the internet. Headings take the brand's indigo by name.
The same file styles the Typst PDF: its colours, its fonts, and here the logo. Word keeps its styles in reference-doc.

final:
color:
  palette:
    indigo: "#4137A8"
    green: "#00803A"
    dark: "#2C2D3F"
  primary: indigo
  foreground: dark

typography:
  fonts:
    - family: Tajawal
      source: file
      files:
        - path: fonts/Tajawal-Regular.ttf
          weight: 400
        - path: fonts/Tajawal-Bold.ttf
          weight: 700
  base: Tajawal
  headings:
    family: Tajawal
    weight: 700
    color: indigo

logo:
  medium: gastat-logo-color.png
